text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) Capital Budget Variance for the four months ended on April 30, 2019. As of April 30, 2019, TPH spent $1.418 million, representing 29.2 percent of the 2019 Approved Capital Budget of $4.864 million.
The Board of Health received the report (May 31, 2019) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
